properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign JWT access tokens. Must be at least 32 bytes (256 bits). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 64

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT access token lifetime in milliseconds. Default: 900000 (15 minutes).

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration-ms
properties.description: Refresh token lifetime in milliseconds. Default: 604800000 (7 days).

properties.name: ml.service.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Python ML recommendation service called by CourseRecommendationService and DeptRecommendationService.

properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Base URL of the React frontend. Used when constructing password-reset links sent via email.

properties.name: reset.token-expiration-ms
properties.description: Password reset token lifetime in milliseconds. Default: 900000 (15 minutes).

properties.name: app.storage.upload-dir
properties.description: Directory where uploaded material files are stored. Relative to the JVM working directory or an absolute path. Created automatically on startup. Default: 'uploads'.
